description:
Follow-up to op-gv19 (kovan-native annotations) and GitHub issue #30 -- the
maintainer noticed annotations made in Okular don't show up in kovan's PDF
reader at all. Diagnosis: kopitiam-pdf's rasterize_page/hayro never read or
draw a page's /Annots array; kovan's own "Annotation" feature (op-x9qn) is a
separate, kovan-native in-memory overlay unrelated to the PDF's embedded
annotation objects.

Tried native-in-kovan first (per explicit maintainer direction), fell back
to inspecting Poppler/Okular source only for license verification and
reference -- no code vendored, since kopitiam-pdf's already-public
PdfDocument/Object API turned out to be sufficient. Implemented:

- crates/kovan/src/digitiser/gui/desktop/pdf_annots.rs (new): reads /Annots
  per page via PdfDocument::page/resolve_get/Object (all public), for
  Highlight/Underline/StrikeOut/Squiggly/Text/Popup/FreeText/Square/Circle/
  Line/Ink -- geometry (/Rect, /QuadPoints, /L, /InkList), colour (/C, /IC,
  reusing kopitiam_pdf's own gray_to_rgb/cmyk_to_rgb), opacity (/CA),
  contents/author (/Contents, /T, PDF text-string decoding), and /F
  Hidden/NoView flag filtering. Skips Link/Widget/other subtypes.
- Independent re-derivation of the PDF-user-space -> RENDER_DPI
  texture-pixel-space transform (kopitiam-pdf's own page_ctm is
  pub(crate)), self-validated against a REAL rasterize_page render in
  tests -- caught a genuine width/height-swap bug in the /Rotate 90/270
  branches that a square-page test would have missed (fixed with a
  deliberately non-square test fixture).
- Wired into pdf_reader.rs: drawn as an overlay under kovan's own
  annotations in both single-page and continuous-scroll mode, with a hover
  tooltip (Contents + author) in single-page mode.

Known limitation, filed upstream: this draws a geometry+colour
APPROXIMATION, not the annotation's real /AP appearance stream --
kopitiam-pdf's content-stream interpreter (Processor::new/run_stream) is
pub(crate), so kovan can't execute it. Filed as kopitiam#69
(https://github.com/theodoreOnzGit/kopitiam/issues/69), tracked here as
op-5xcq (closed -- filing was the task; the upstream fix is a future bead
once kopitiam#69 ships).

Verified: cargo test --release -p kovan --features gui --lib (209 passed,
incl. 5 new pdf_annots tests) and cargo check --workspace --lib --tests
(clean). No manual GUI click-test -- same headless-sandbox wgpu-surface
limitation already flagged on op-95x6.

notes.content: Reopened in effect by op-k1nt: the /Annots reader shipped in 8975b176 is correct, but annotations were still invisible in the GUI. Root cause is upstream -- kopitiam-pdf's rasterize_page poisons the object cache with pre-incremental-update objects, so the reader gets the stale /Annots array for any Okular-saved (incrementally updated) PDF. Filed kopitiam#70; diagnostics + failing-coverage analysis pushed as 0ea169c3. Workaround and regression fixture tracked in op-k1nt.

title: kovan-gui: PDF reader renders embedded /Annots (Okular highlights/notes) natively

description:
OPEN follow-up to op-87ae. Root cause found and pushed as 0ea169c3
(diagnostics + tests only; NO fix yet).

THE BUG (upstream, kopitiam#70): kopitiam-pdf's rasterize_page poisons
PdfDocument's object cache with pre-incremental-update objects. A PDF saved
as an incremental update (appended objects + new xref chained via /Prev --
what Okular writes when it saves annotations) holds two versions of the
page's indirect /Annots array. Whichever access populates the cache first
wins, and kovan's reader always rasterizes (to build the texture) before
reading annotations, so it gets the stale pre-annotation version.

Measured, same bytes, same process:
  read only                -> 8 entries (3 Widget + 5 Ink)  correct
  rasterize, then read     -> 3 entries (Widget only)       stale
  read, rasterize, re-read -> 8 entries                     correct

WHAT REMAINS HERE:
1. Workaround: resolve+cache annotations for every page at open time, in
   open_pdf(), AFTER reset_interaction_state() clears the cache but BEFORE
   anything rasterizes. Case C above shows a correctly-warmed cache
   survives later rasterization. Cost is one dict walk per page (no
   rendering); note the tradeoff in the doc comment.
2. Regression fixture: a synthetic, incrementally-updated PDF built from
   spec bytes -- base body with an /Annots array object holding one Widget,
   then an appended section rewriting that same object to Widget+Ink with a
   second classic xref whose trailer carries /Prev. The two end-to-end
   tests added in 0ea169c3 both PASS and did not catch this, because
   neither fixture is an incremental update -- that is the exact coverage
   gap. Test must rasterize FIRST, then assert the Ink is still read.
3. Once kopitiam#70 ships a fix: re-run the three-way A/B/C probe against
   the published version, drop the workaround if it is genuinely fixed, and
   keep the regression fixture either way.
4. Decide whether KOVAN_ANNOT_DEBUG stays long-term (currently documented
   in pdf_reader.rs's module doc as the supported diagnostic).

Also open: kopitiam#69 -- no public content-stream interpreter entry point,
so annotation /AP appearance streams still cannot be rendered faithfully;
kovan draws a geometry+colour approximation instead (op-5xcq).
title: kovan-gui: work around kopitiam#70 -- resolve /Annots before rasterizing, + incremental-update regression fixture
